  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_001",
    "title": "Validate Successful LTE Attach and Detach for Multiple UEs under Excellent Radio Conditions",
    "description": "Verify that multiple UEs (at least 2) can successfully attach and detach to/from an LTE cell under excellent radio conditions, with 100% attach and detach success rate over 10 iterations.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network configured as a single isolated LTE cell with other cells powered off.",
      "Multiple stationary UEs placed under excellent radio conditions as per LTE RSRP defined in Clause 4.6.",
      "Test configuration parameters recorded and available."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Access the 5G management interface via SSH using `admin@<IP>` and authenticate.",
      "Configure the LTE cell and verify it is active and unloaded.",
      "Place multiple UEs under excellent LTE radio conditions near the radiated eNB antenna.",
      "Start logging call flow and signalling messages to capture attach-detach procedures.",
      "Power ON all UEs to initiate LTE Attach procedure.",
      "Wait for all UEs to complete the attach procedure successfully.",
      "Verify UE logs/applications confirm attachment to the correct cell (e.g., PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN).",
      "Power OFF all UEs to initiate LTE Detach procedure.",
      "Wait for all UEs to complete the detach procedure successfully.",
      "Stop and save the test logs.",
      "Repeat steps 4 to 10 for a total of 10 iterations.",
      "Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, average, max) for each UE."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs attach and detach successfully in all 10 iterations with 100% success rate.",
      "Attach latency is within expected thresholds as per Table 5-5.",
      "Signalling messages confirm correct LTE attach and detach procedures as per 3GPP TS 23.401.",
      "No connectivity issues during the test."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "Test logs saved for reference.",
      "KPIs recorded in test report as per Table 5-4 and Table 5-5."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "SSH admin@<IP>"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Log analysis of attach and detach signalling messages",
      "UE application logs verification for cell attachment",
      "KPIs measurement and comparison with expected values"
    ]
  },

      "Configure the 5G NSA cell and verify it is active and unloaded.",

      "Start logging call flow and signalling messages to capture attach-detach procedures and EN-DC flows.",
      "Power ON all UEs to initiate 5G NSA Attach procedure including Secondary Node Addition.",
      "Wait for all UEs to complete the attach and secondary node addition procedure successfully.",
      "Verify UE logs/applications confirm attachment to the correct LTE and 5G cells (PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN, NR-ARFCN).",

      "Stop and save the test logs.",

      "Calculate and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate for each UE."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs attach, secondary node add, detach, and secondary node release successfully in all 10 iterations with 100% success rate.",
      "Signalling messages confirm correct procedures as per 3GPP TS 23.401 and 3GPP TS 37.340.",
      "No connectivity issues during the test."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "Test logs saved for reference.",
      "KPIs recorded in test report as per Table 5-4."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "SSH admin@<IP>"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Log analysis of attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release signalling messages",
      "UE application logs verification for cell attachment",
      "KPIs measurement and comparison with expected values"
    ]
  },
